headline: On November 7, 1994: WXYC launched the world's first internet radio broadcast
captionCards: Pioneered live web audio streaming before widespread internet use
instagramCaption:
WXYC made history on November 7, 1994.

The student-run radio station at UNC Chapel Hill became the first in the world to stream live over the internet.

Broadcasting from a 147-meter antenna with 1,100 watts of power, it reached 900 square miles across North Carolina.

Its signal was transmitted via the web—before most people even had home internet access.

This milestone laid the foundation for today’s global online radio landscape.

What would you have tuned into if you could listen back then?
